gold.question: Along the process flow path from P-2-1 to E-21-1, which item has the lowest maximum allowable pressure according to its datasheet? Give the value for every item on the path that has a datasheet.

candidate: The items on the path from P-2-1 to E-21-1 with datasheet pressure ratings are: P-2-1 (max operating pressure 1723 kPa / 250 psi at 37°C; max casing pressure 1834 kPa / 266 psi), CHV-21-1 and CHV-21-2 (check valves, max working pressure 413 bar / 6000 psig, with max back pressure varying by variant up to 6000 psig), FV-2-1 (control valve, max inlet pressure consistent with CL600 per ASME B16.34, max pressure/temperature limits up to 104 bar / 1500 psig with graphite packing), and E-21-1 (max design pressure 10.3 barg / 150 psig per ASME, or 16.0 barg / 232 psig per PED). The item with the lowest maximum allowable pressure is E-21-1 at 10.3 barg (150 psig, ASME code).

gold.question: Compare the transmitter that measures P-5-1 and the valve operated by control loop FIC-2-1: which of the two has the lowest maximum allowable pressure according to its datasheet, and what are the two values?

gold.question: For each item that receives flow directly from P-7-2, what is its maximum allowable pressure according to its datasheet, and which of them has the lowest?

candidate: The items receiving flow directly from P-7-2 are the exchanger E-7-1 and the control valve PV-7-2. E-7-1's datasheet lists a maximum design pressure of 10.3 barg (150 psig) for the ASME pressure vessel code frame, or 16.0 barg (232 psig) for the PED code frame. PV-7-2's datasheet gives a maximum pressure/temperature limit of 104 bar (1500 psig) with ENVIRO-SEAL Graphite ULF packing (with a lower rating, full CL300 up to 232°C/450°F, for the PTFE/Duplex packing used to meet the EPA 100 ppm fugitive-emission standard). Of these, E-7-1 has the lowest maximum allowable pressure, 10.3 barg under the ASME code condition.
